name: Iijima Ryousuke
source:
25 years old (Ubai)
26 years old (Ubai Again)
27 years old (Ubai Ending)

Wishes to be a cameraman, so he got employed at a video production company, but due to a scandal involving a woman, the said company went bankrupt. 

The scandal was widely known, so he was having a hard time getting reemployed. It was at the time that Ubai picked him up.

Because he was a newbie, he did miscellaneous jobs, and sometimes even worked as an AV actor. He was also like an assistant director. 

Has a fetish for "women's adultery", and so he gets excited with both "netori" and "netorare". He is Asami's ex-boyfriend.
